description: NaLiTiAl(PO₄)₃ crystallizes in the monoclinic C2 space group. Na is bonded in a distorted hexagonal planar geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.38-2.53 Å. Li is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Li-O bond distances ranging from 2.07-2.54 Å. Ti is bonded to six O atoms to form TiO₆ octahedra that share corners with six PO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Ti-O bond distances ranging from 1.94-1.96 Å. Al is bonded to six O atoms to form AlO₆ octahedra that share corners with six PO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Al-O bond distances ranging from 1.82-2.01 Å. There are four inequivalent P sites. In the first P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent TiO₆ octahedra and corners with two equivalent AlO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 25-36°. All P-O bond lengths are 1.55 Å. In the second P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent TiO₆ octahedra and corners with two equivalent AlO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 25-35°. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.52-1.55 Å. In the third P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent TiO₆ octahedra and corners with two equivalent AlO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 25-37°. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.53-1.56 Å. In the fourth P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent TiO₆ octahedra and corners with two equivalent AlO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 31-34°. There are two shorter (1.54 Å) and two longer (1.55 Å) P-O bond lengths. There are twelve inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one Al and one P atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to one Li, one Al, and one P atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to one Na, one Li, one Al, and one P atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one Ti and one P atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Ti, and one P atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Li, one Al, and one P atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Ti, and one P atom. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to one Na, one Li, one Al, and one P atom. In the ninth O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one Ti and one P atom. In the tenth O site, O is bonded to one Na, two equivalent Li, one Al, and one P atom to form distorted corner-sharing ONaLi₂AlP trigonal bipyramids. In the eleventh O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Ti, and one P atom. In the twelfth O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one Ti and one P atom.
